## Keyboard shortcuts

Press `←` or `→` to navigate between chapters

Press `S` or `/` to search in the book

Press `?` to show this help

Press `Esc` to hide this help

【0†iframe】

# Rust By Example
# 【1†Conversion】

Primitive types can be converted to each other through 【2†casting】.

Rust addresses conversion between custom types (i.e., `struct` and `enum`) by the use of 【3†traits】. The generic conversions will use the 【4†`From`】 and 【5†`Into`】 traits. However there are more specific ones for the more common cases, in particular when converting to and from `String`s.
